profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at DoorDash
profile.summary:
Curious Software Engineer with experience designing, building, and maintaining large scale, performant, and resilient systems and infrastructure. Experience working with large microservices architectures, ephemeral and persistent datastores, and streaming solutions on managed providers. Interested in Autonomous Vehicles!

In my free time, I enjoy video games, like League of legends, and anime. My wife and I live in Oakland with our two cats, Lily Pichu and Zuko.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mapping - Localization (Infra + streaming)

Created Lyft-wide geofence stream processing platform to trigger events for transient, user-specific geofences, delivering infra cost reduction, 68% decrease in engineering time, and 99% decrease in RPS vs existing solutions
Refactored and migrated Lyft’s core end-of-ride mapmatching code path to incorporate more map data, decreasing latency by 50%/85% (p50, p999), reducing usage of secondary models by 58%, and improving perf for longer rides
Designed, built and maintained complex projects to replace Lyft’s core location data model. Improved ETA accuracy while managing latency constraints, networking and infrastructure costs, and strict SLOs/SLAs
Provisioned, migrated, and validated various tables across Redis, DynamoDB, and Hive saving $1.3M in annual revenue by improving storage and leveraging managed cloud solutions (AWS)
Influenced long-term planning, system-level architecture design, and tech spec review by creating alignment across 4+ teams, communicating implementation trade-offs to peers and leaders, and considering failure scenarios.
Represented team in technical discussions, mentored junior engineers, and managed a weekly, team-wide brownbag series to decentralize system knowledge alongside team documentation

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bridgekin is changing the way people connect with each-other and the business opportunities within their network.

Lead Full-stack Engineer
- Experience building single page, consumer-facing web applications at scale, leveraging front-end JavaScript frameworks (React) and UI frameworks
- Experience designing schemas, data flows and data object models, primarily working with complex relational databases and briefly with graph databases
- Experience operating at all levels of the stack, debugging problems from UI to backend systems
- Varying experiences integrating tools and features for payments (stripe), mapping (Google Maps),  AWS (Caching-Cloudfront, S3), etc

- Ruby on Rails, React/Redux, Material UI, HTML/CSS/JS, SQL, AWS, PostgreSQL, ActiveAdmin, AWS (S3, Cloudfront, ElasticSearch), Redis, Sidekiq, Cypher, Neo4j (Graph DB)
- Topics: Object-Oriented Programming, Algorithms, Authentication, Authorization, Graph Algorithms and traversal, Caching

positions.title: Program Manager - Marcom Attribution and Measurement
positions.description:
- Led Attribution program strategy as primary POC and functional subject matter expert around both Multi-Touch Attribution and Last-Touch Attribution, assessing gaps, risks, and opportunities
- Build Attribution scripts and data ingestion promos for use on Multi-Touch Attribution
- Workflow management and scope definition, pathing roadmap for operationalized Attribution
- Managed exec conversation among stakeholders, ensuring program positioned answer the right, cross-functional goals
- Supported and owned reporting and status updates across exec leadership and CFX partners

positions.title: Global Media Strategist
positions.description:
- Effectively led global paid media strategy, spanning 35 countries for various EA titles, across all media channels including social, programmatic and search, reaching internal goals with budgets upward of $6M
- Collaborated with cross-function groups across company to develop integrated global media flighting, plan, execution, and reporting
- Led media testing initiatives across titles, focusing on internal KPIs, and developed actionable insights for relevant titles
- Expert buying experience around Social media across Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube with proficient experience with Programmatic media, and Search media, across Google, Yahoo, and Bing,
- Worked closely with both E-commerce/Live services-based campaigns as well as off-line conversion-based products

positions.title: Global Media Buyer
positions.description: Contributed as a social media buyer across major AAA titles such as Madden and Star Wars Battlefront. Managed multi-million dollar social budgets across Twitter, YouTube, and Facebook. Cultivated testing strategies and executions to further creative learnings and attribution agendas across company

positions.title: Finance Intern at Evolution Fresh Direct Store Delivery
positions.description:
•	Developed user-friendly Dashboard Reports for DSD Operations covering fundamental financial metrics and other key performance indicators (KPIs)
•	Mapped a complete Implementation Plan to launch Dashboard system while also shaping the operating culture
•	Trained Order Desk personnel in order to sustain Dashboard Reporting system going forward
•	Built foundation for reporting architecture that will allow significantly improved visibility on all DSD operations

projects.title: The Last Explorer
projects.description: Javascript, Html5 / Css3, Animation · Last Explorer is a 2d side-scrolling shooter, where the hero must defeat all enemies on the level.

projects.title: AirBnAnime
projects.description: This site is an AirBnB clone, in which users can experience the core functionality of AirBnB, including booking homes, searching listings, and leaving reviews for their favorite anime hosts.
